```python
import json
from typing import Any

def _render_minimal_universal(policy: dict[str, Any], max_chars: int = 4000) -> str:
    """Re-render the universal directive minimally, preserving all HARD constraints.
    
    Extracts policy configuration and hardcodes the irreducible CDSFL behavioral 
    directives. Strips all prose, examples, and markdown.
    """
    hard_behavioral = [
        "Classify constraints as HARD or SOFT; ambiguous defaults to HARD.",
        "Precedence: physics/math > legal/safety > user-specified.",
        "Iterate falsification: state falsifier, try to satisfy, revise.",
        "Skip falsification for mechanical facts; full loop for novel claims.",
        "Corroboration: each survived pass increases trust (diminishing returns).",
        "3+ modules: 1 pass per module + 1 isolated adversarial pass.",
        "Mark present-state claims [VERIFY:current], untested inferences [SPECULATIVE].",
        "Verify facts with search if available, else flag.",
        "Push back on impossible requirements; never fabricate certainty.",
        "Default to simplest sufficient solution.",
        "Flag tangential requests and prioritize core task.",
        "End with definitive stance: what was done, what comes next."
    ]
    
    flat_policy = []
    def _flatten(d: dict, prefix: str = "") -> None:
        for k, v in sorted(d.items()):
            path = f"{prefix}.{k}" if prefix else k
            if isinstance(v, dict):
                _flatten(v, path)
            elif v is True:
                flat_policy.append(f"{path}=true")
            elif isinstance(v, (int, float, str)) and v != "":
                flat_policy.append(f"{path}={v}")
                
    _flatten(policy)
    
    lines = ["CDSFL CORE MINIMAL", "== BEHAVIORAL =="]
    lines.extend(f"- {b}" for b in hard_behavioral)
    lines.append("== POLICY ==")
    lines.extend(f"- {p}" for p in flat_policy)
    
    text = "\n".join(lines)
    if len(text) > max_chars:
        return text[:max_chars - 20] + "\n[TRUNCATED]"
    return text
```

```python
import re
from dataclasses import replace

def _intra_packet_prune(packet: 'DirectivePacket', max_chars: int) -> 'DirectivePacket':
    """Prune SOFT directives inside a single packet to fit a character budget."""
    if len(packet.text) <= max_chars:
        return packet
        
    blocks = re.split(r'\n\s*\n', packet.text.strip())
    hard_markers = {"HARD", "MUST", "REQUIRED", "NEVER", "ALWAYS", "FORBIDDEN"}
    
    hard_blocks = []
    soft_blocks = []
    
    for block in blocks:
        if packet.constraint_class == "HARD" or any(m in block.upper() for m in hard_markers):
            hard_blocks.append(block)
        else:
            soft_blocks.append(block)
            
    retained_text = "\n\n".join(hard_blocks)
    
    for sb in soft_blocks:
        if len(retained_text) + len(sb) + 2 <= max_chars:
            retained_text += "\n\n" + sb
            
    return replace(packet, text=retained_text.strip())
```

```python
import re

def _apply_phenotype_transform(text: str, transform: 'PhenotypeTransform') -> str:
    """Apply structural, compression, and deduplication rules per model."""
    if transform.strip_examples:
        text = re.sub(r'(?im)^(example[s]?|e\.g\.)[:\n].*?(?=\n\n|\Z)', '', text, flags=re.DOTALL)

    if transform.strip_rationale:
        text = re.sub(r'(?im)^(why|rationale|motivation|reason)[:\n].*?(?=\n\n|\Z)', '', text, flags=re.DOTALL)

    if getattr(transform, 'compress_tables', False):
        lines = []
        for line in text.split("\n"):
            if "|" in line and line.strip().startswith("|"):
                cells = [c.strip() for c in line.split("|") if c.strip() and set(c.strip()) != {"-"}]
                if cells:
                    lines.append(", ".join(cells))
            else:
                lines.append(line)
        text = "\n".join(lines)

    if getattr(transform, 'format_style', '') == 'minimal':
        # a) Remove markdown headers, replace with plain text labels
        text = re.sub(r'^#+\s+(.*)$', r'\1:', text, flags=re.MULTILINE)
        
        # b) Collapse multi-line directives
        blocks = re.split(r'\n\s*\n', text)
        collapsed_blocks = [" ".join(b.split()) for b in blocks if b.strip()]
        
        # c) Deduplicate
        seen = set()
        deduped = []
        for b in collapsed_blocks:
            b_norm = b.lower()
            if b_norm not in seen:
                seen.add(b_norm)
                deduped.append(b)
        text = "\n\n".join(deduped)

    if len(text) > transform.max_directive_chars:
        text = text[:transform.max_directive_chars] + "\n[... truncated for capacity]"

    return text
```

```python
from dataclasses import replace

def resolve_interactions(composed: 'ComposedDirectiveSet') -> 'ComposedDirectiveSet':
    """Resolve conflicts between layers (e.g., SOFT domain rules vs phenotype format)."""
    style = composed.manifest.get("phenotype_transform", {}).get("format_style", "full")
    is_minimal = style == "minimal"
    
    conflict_keywords = ["detailed", "verbose", "comprehensive", "exhaustive", "proofs", "step-by-step"]
    conflicts_logged = []
    resolved_packets = []
    
    for packet in composed.packets:
        if packet.layer == "domain" and is_minimal and packet.constraint_class == "SOFT":
            resolved_lines = []
            for line in packet.text.split("\n"):
                if any(kw in line.lower() for kw in conflict_keywords):
                    conflicts_logged.append(f"Pruned conflicting SOFT rule: {line[:40]}...")
                else:
                    resolved_lines.append(line)
            resolved_packets.append(replace(packet, text="\n".join(resolved_lines)))
        else:
            resolved_packets.append(packet)
            
    new_text = "\n\n---\n\n".join(p.text for p in resolved_packets if p.text.strip())
    
    manifest = composed.manifest.copy()
    manifest["resolved_conflicts"] = conflicts_logged
    
    return replace(composed, packets=resolved_packets, rendered_text=new_text, manifest=manifest)
```

```python
import json
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict

def calibrate_coherence_budgets(log_file_paths: list[Path]) -> dict[str, float]:
    """Calculates optimal coherence thresholds where finding quality drops > 10% from peak."""
    model_data = defaultdict(list)
    
    for path in log_file_paths:
        if not path.exists(): continue
        runs = json.loads(path.read_text())
        for run in runs:
            density = round(run["constraint_density"], 3)
            tokens = max(run["tokens"], 1)
            rate = (run["findings"] / tokens) * 1000
            model_data[run["model"]].append((density, rate))
            
    optimal_budgets = {}
    
    for model, runs in model_data.items():
        density_rates = defaultdict(list)
        for d, r in runs:
            density_rates[d].append(r)
            
        avg_rates = {d: sum(rs)/len(rs) for d, rs in density_rates.items()}
        if not avg_rates:
            continue
            
        sorted_densities = sorted(avg_rates.keys())
        peak_density = max(avg_rates, key=avg_rates.get)
        peak_rate = avg_rates[peak_density]
        
        threshold = peak_density
        for d in sorted_densities:
            if d > peak_density:
                if avg_rates[d] < peak_rate * 0.90:
                    break  # Found drop point, keep previous threshold
                threshold = d  # Sustained above 90%, update threshold
                
        optimal_budgets[model] = threshold
        
    return optimal_budgets
```
